answer: Work slots are scarce ledges: each agent may hold one, and claiming one burns a 40 POA deposit, never refunded. A canyon of cost separates one honest agent from a sybil farm: 100 fake identities burn 4,000 POA before earning anything, while one deposit is a share of one month's honest income. Claims go on a crystal-clear ledger, so duplicates are visible at once. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot; a farm's burned deposits buy nothing.
